Game Overview

Iron Bird Shooter puts players into a airplane experience centered on pilot your iron bird through intense skies, dodging enemy ships and collecting essential items to enhance your survival. Gather gold coins to rack up scores and prove your prowess. With intuitive controls and endless fun, it's a thrilling adventure for all ages to enjoy anytime, anywhere.

How to Play

Iron Bird Shooter keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Pilot your iron bird through intense skies, dodging enemy ships and collecting essential items to enhance your survival. Gather gold coins to rack up scores and prove your prowess. With intuitive controls and endless fun, it's a thrilling adventure for all ages to enjoy anytime, anywhere.
